# L1 Rule Catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

These are the stable rule IDs accepted by execution-gate `rules`. A missing rule ID is enabled. Model gates such as `native:pii`, `native:dlp`, and `native:injection_l1` control complete producers; rule gates control individual entries below.
